**First, let me update the address for your orders:**

I'll update the shipping address from 443 Maple Drive to 445 Maple Drive for both pending orders (#W9583042 and #W4082615). The rest of the address will stay the same (Suite 394, Fort Worth, TX 76165).

**Second, for the puzzle change:**

I'll change your 1000-piece intermediate art puzzle to the 500-piece beginner animals puzzle in order #W4082615. This will save you $7.98, and the refund will go back to your original payment method (PayPal).

Let me start with updating the address. Do you confirm you want me to update the address to 445 Maple Drive for both orders? (Please respond with "yes" to confirm)
